REMARKS:
280900Z POSITION NEAR 16.7N 81.8E.
28OCT26. TROPICAL CYCLONE 02B (ARNAB), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 527
NM SOUTHWEST OF KOLKATA, INDIA, HAS TRACKED NORTHEASTWARD AT 03
KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. AS TROPICAL CYCLONE (TC) 02B APPROACHED 
LAND THIS MORNING, IT RAPIDLY DECELERATED, AND TURNING SOUTHWESTWARD, 
DUE TO THE COMBINED EFFECTS OF LAND INTERACTION AND BINARY INTERACTION 
WITH INVEST 90B TO THE EAST. THE SYSTEM SKIRTED THE COAST OF THE 
GODAVARI RIVER DELTA, REACHING A POSITION SOUTHWEST OF NARSAPUR BY 
0000Z. SINCE THAT TIME, THE SYSTEM HAS SLOWLY DRIFTED NORTHWARD AND IS 
NOW SITUATED ALONG THE COASTLINE, IN THE VICINITY OF NARSAPUR BASED ON 
ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE IMAGERY (MSI) AND RADAR DATA FROM 
IMD.  SURFACE OBS FROM NARSAPUR REPORT LIGHT WINDS, AND MEAN SEA LEVEL 
PRESSURE OF 988MB, WHICH SUPPORTS THE INITIAL INTENSITY OF 55 KNOTS 
WITH MEDIUM CONFIDENCE. NOW THAT INVEST 90B HAS MADE LANDFALL AND IS 
MOVING RAPIDLY NORTHWESTWARD INTO INTERIOR INDIA, 02B SHOULD START 
LIFTING NORTHWARD, MOVING ALONG THE WESTERN SIDE OF THE SUBTROPICAL 
RIDGE (STR) TO THE EAST. 02B WILL CONTINUE TO STEADILY WEAKEN OVER THE 
NEXT 36 HOURS, BEFORE DISSIPATING OVER NORTHEASTERN INDIA.
THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON
WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR
SIGNS OF REGEN
